title: Streamdown: The Streaming-Optimized Markdown Renderer for AI Apps

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Imagine bringing the power of AI generated content to life without the formatting glitches that streaming markdown usually creates. Meet Streamdown, a dropin replacement for React Markdown, built specifically for AI powered streaming. Traditional Markdown parsers expect complete documents. But AI outputs arrive one fragment at a time unfinished, malformed, and unpredictable. Streamdown solved that challenge, giving you seamless rendering even with incomplete or unterminated markdown. With Streamdown, you get a streaming optimized engine that gracefully handles bold, italics, code, links, and headings, even when they aren't closed yet. It fully supports GitHub flavor markdown with tables, task lists, and strike through. It renders math equations on the fly with KAX and even supports mermaid diagrams with a one-click render button. For developers, syntax highlighting counts building with Shiki, making code blocks as beautiful as they are accurate. And all of it is done with security first rendering powered by harden react markdown, ensuring content is safe to display.

Streamdown isn't just fast, it's efficient with memoise rendering under the hood. Performance stays smooth even with rapidfire AI responses. Whether you're building chat interfaces, AIdriven documentation, or any live streaming markdown experience, Streamdown is designed to plug in seamlessly and just Work.
